Hi Jessica / Tom,

Thanks for the productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Scope: 3-week pilot (approx. 500k tokens/month) focused on clinical note summarization; Redwood will configure prefix caching and provide a fine-tuned prompt set.
- Pilot deliverables: baseline eval, latency/cost report, and a handbook for integration.
- Decision makers: Jessica (clinical lead / economic buyer) to confirm final PO owner; Tom to shepherd procurement path.
- Security/legal: Medicomp needs SOC 2 (redacted is ok) and a DPA.
- Procurement path: Tom mentioned routing invoices via procurement@medicomp.com; estimated PO timing ~6-8 weeks following budget approval.

Action items: 
1) Monica: send updated SOW + SOC 2 redacted report (attached) — target: EOD today
2) Tom: confirm procurement contact + preferred invoice remit and billing contact — target: 11/26
3) Jessica: confirm economic owner and PO cadence — target: 11/24

Attachments: SOW_redwood_v2.pdf (draft), SOC2_report_redacted.pdf

If that aligns I'll send the SOW to procurement and loop in Legal for the DPA.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

Monica,

Thanks for the clear summary — that matches our notes. A few clarifications and next items from procurement:

I'll confirm the exact billing contact and remit instructions by Thursday (11/26) and paste them here so you can update your invoice details.
